base: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied Pheeeew annoyed pink character into exactly ONE requested game jump pose. Image 1 front, image 2 left-facing side, image 3 three-quarter are identity/style references. This is the SAME character, no redesign. Preserve pale pink watercolor mottled tissue-paper texture, darker pink lower/right shading, bold black hand-drawn outline (about 12px at 1024), white upper-left glossy highlights, simple mitten hands and oval feet. Preserve annoyed face: inward sloping eyebrows, flat half-lidded eyes with black hanging pupils, curved downturned frown, two saturated pink oval cheeks, ONE muted purple PLUS sign on forehead. Side view uses one visible eye/cheek and curved frown near left silhouette as in reference. NO smile, open mouth, surprise, extra symbols, props, wall, floor, shadow, motion lines, dust, sweat, text, or checkerboard. Real alpha transparent background. 1024x1024 PNG, full character uncropped, generous margins. Lowest visible pixel y=900, overall horizontal center x=512. Body width approximately 770px; hands/feet compact enough to fit canvas. Keep body mass and visual identity; squashed poses are wider and shallower, stretched poses slightly narrower and taller.

poses.jump_charge: FRONT view. Deep preparatory crouch: rounded body squashed down and broadened, body height approximately 410px, width approximately 800px. Both mitten hands braced DOWN near ground at lower corners, two oval feet planted at bottom. Face fully visible with unchanged irritated expression. More compressed than landing, much less flattened than splat.
poses.jump_rise: LEFT-facing SIDE view, rising upper-left. Body gently vertically stretched, body height about 675px, width about 750px; lean top slightly upper-left. Mitten arms swept BACK AND DOWN toward right, oval feet dangling DOWN below body. Exact left-facing annoyed profile from side reference. Compact limbs and slightly elongated body; no extreme thin oval.
poses.jump_apex: LEFT-facing SIDE view, hovering at jump apex. Body returned to original round domed shape, width about 770px, height about 600px. Mitten hands and oval feet gently spread, relaxed airborne pose with small separation from body. Exact annoyed side profile. No floor or shadow.
poses.jump_fall: LEFT-facing SIDE view falling. Body gently vertically stretched, width about 750px, height about 650px. Both short mitten hands raised UP beside the upper body, no fingers. Both feet pulled UP close to lower body, no dangling feet. Exact annoyed side profile; NOT surprised. Keep whole silhouette less than 880px tall.
poses.jump_land: FRONT view instant of landing. Body compressed to broad dome, about 795px wide and 500px tall, less squashed than charge. Both mitten arms spread sideways for balance, compact and close to body; both oval feet on bottom. Face keeps angry half-lidded eyes, frown, pink cheeks and purple plus; no action effects.
poses.jump_wall: LEFT-facing SIDE view impact into invisible wall on LEFT. Left face/body edge visibly pressed into a long straight vertical plane at x about 125, right rear of body round. Body width about 770px and height about 610px. Annoyed profile face at flattened LEFT edge, recognizable eye, cheek and frown; single purple forehead plus. Both compact hands and both feet recoil BACK toward RIGHT. No wall drawn, no lines or sparks. Clearly flat vertical left body edge, NOT round left edge.
poses.jump_splat: FRONT view flattened prone after high fall. Body extremely flattened broad low dome/pancake, width about 800px, height about 280px, much flatter than charge and landing. Both mitten hands and BOTH oval feet stretch sideways compactly, four distinct small appendages. Face remains visible across front with exact annoyed half-lidded eyes, frown, cheeks and purple plus. No standing stance, no feet underneath, no puddle, no shadow.

pose_revision_instructions.jump_charge: Keep the FRONT view and exact face. Make the body visibly more SQUASHED: decrease ONLY the body height by 22% while retaining the same body width. Low broad rounded dome, hands pressed down at bottom corners, two planted feet. It should be about twice as wide as it is tall, not a normal standing pose.
pose_revision_instructions.jump_apex: Keep LEFT facing side view, identical face and gently splayed floating feet. Change body silhouette to a wider LOW ROUNDED dome: body width 800 units and body height 600 units (height is only THREE QUARTERS of width). It must NOT be a tall egg. Compact airborne hands/feet.
pose_revision_instructions.jump_fall: Keep LEFT facing side view, both hands UP and both feet tucked against belly. Decrease body height 18% retaining width and exact face. Body width 790 units and body height 680 units; wider than tall. Keep a gentle vertical stretch relative to low reference dome, not a tall egg.
